summary: Full E2E backend + frontend test of ClientVerse.io. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass, and all 10 required E2E flows pass in Playwright including admin login, dashboard KPIs & portfolio, pipeline CRUD, directory CRUD, workspaces list + detail, explainable client health panel, evidence-backed AI generation (health summary), governed registries across 4 tabs, audit event feed, new-tenant registration and multi-tenant isolation.

design_issues.screen: All Dialogs (New Opportunity, New Company, New Contact, New Workspace)
issues: Missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby on Radix DialogContent - a11y warning printed for every modal open

action_items: (Low priority a11y) Add DialogDescription to each DialogContent (Pipeline, Directory, Workspaces) to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 694 lines and monolithic - close to but under 700 LOC threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, pipeline, workspaces, ai, registry) for maintainability.
AI endpoint /api/ai/generate returns raw model string; adequate for MVP but consider streaming and adding token/cost telemetry.
Registry endpoint path is /api/registry/{kind} (singular) while frontend URL slug and page path are /registries (plural). Works but inconsistent naming.
get_workspace does a per-workspace loop of separate collection queries in /dashboard (N+1). Acceptable at demo scale; may need aggregation for large tenants.
record_event stored in domain_events with sort by timestamp - ensure an index on (tenant_id, timestamp) for scale.
test_credentials: Admin admin@example.com / [REDACTED_TEST_PASSWORD] works. Registration flow creates isolated tenant.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_-prefixed companies/contacts/opportunities in admin tenant and one new-tenant user per run. AI health-summary AI run also persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints: registry is /api/registry/{kind} (singular), stage change is PATCH /api/opportunities/{id}/stage, workspace detail returns { workspace, company, tasks, deliverables, requests, approvals, commitments, events, health }. AI returns { output, sources, run_id, model_version, prompt_version, policy_version, confidence, freshness }. All required data-testid attributes exist and are stable. Tenant isolation verified: new registered user sees 0 companies/workspaces/events.
